Pseudo-code MCQ: Counting Nested Loops
questions.statement:
What is printed by this pseudo-code?

```
Integer i, j, count
Set count = 0
For (each i from 1 to 4)
    For (each j from i to 4)
        count = count + 1
    End For
End For
Print count
```

questions.title: Pseudo-code MCQ: Loop with Break
questions.statement:
What is printed by this pseudo-code?

```
Integer n, sum
Set sum = 0
For (each n from 1 to 10)
    sum = sum + n
    If (sum > 12) then
        Break out of the loop
    End If
End For
Print n and sum separated by a space
```

Pseudo-code MCQ: Digit Loop
questions.statement:
What is printed by this pseudo-code? (`/` is integer division, `MOD` gives the remainder.)

```
Integer n, s, d
Set n = 4729, s = 0
While (n > 0)
    d = n MOD 10
    If (d MOD 2 EQUALS 0) then
        s = s + d
    Else
        s = s - 1
    End If
    n = n / 10
End While
Print s
```

Pseudo-code MCQ: Double Recursion
questions.statement:
What is printed by this pseudo-code?

```
Function fun(Integer n)
    If (n <= 1) then
        Return n
    End If
    Return fun(n - 1) + fun(n - 2) + 1
End Function

Print fun(5)
```
